purpose: Test the fixed qualified numerical method at 16 well-covered observations; no text or human experiment.

paths.private: new private array/parameter directory, never committed

objective.personal_per_person: mean CE over k supports + rho_adapt/2*||u||^2 + lambda_b_adapt/2*||b||^2

shared_model.ensemble: mean seed probabilities within each one-history condition
shared_model.shared_reuse: one basis per realization/regime/initialization across every history budget, schedule and adaptation policy

generator.family: unchanged rotational generator with parameterized seeds
generator.pairing: adjacent people have identical centered offsets and opposite interaction phases

support.pool: original split_support: first 32 complete training groups in the fixture
support.group_sort: ascending digest, then ascending integer group ID for an exact tie
support.phase_rule: full digest as unsigned big-endian integer modulo 3; cyclic phase,phase+1,phase+2 modulo 3
support.serialization: uppercase C or D; decimal integer seed/group ID without leading zeros; no spaces or trailing newline
support.selection: concatenate complete triplets and take case prefixes
support.same_cases: all people, methods and donor controls share selected question IDs
support.96_reuse: fit once per head/regime/realization in canonical fixture support order; reuse for both schedules
support.partial_groups: allowed only within training partition; no sibling case crosses into query partition
support.k0: B3 and M1 equal B2 analytically; B1 equals training-frequency prior; no optimizer

primary.role: frozen algorithm learning curve; sole predictive qualification policy

count_scaled_secondary.role: preserve 96-support summed-loss ridge precision; descriptive only; cannot rescue primary failure

baselines.B1_prior: own realization and regime training-label frequencies
baselines.B3: offset-only adaptation with the current policy offset penalty

matched_other.construction: row permutation of saved same-budget/same-policy own-history probabilities; one donor, no mixtures
matched_other.evaluation_target: recipient oracle probabilities and sampled outcomes
matched_other.null_expected_pair_average: zero algebraically because paired oracle probabilities are identical; structural sanity check, not evidence of absent spurious interaction

uninformative.M1: analytic u=0 and identical B3 offset problem; construct prediction without extra optimization

optimizer.name: L-BFGS-B
optimizer.failure: record the consumed slot and stop with explicit incomplete state; no replacement seed or retry

numerical_checks.comparison: same first person, individual seed heads before ensembling

metrics.expected_NLL: mean oracle cross entropy over people and query cases; then mean across the two support schedules
metrics.oracle_gap_recovery: averaged gain divided by averaged B3 excess expected NLL over oracle
metrics.contrast: v2 matched-person difference in each of three pairwise class log odds, relative to first canonical query
metrics.contrast_NRMSE: sqrt(mean over histories/pairs/queries/class-contrasts of (D_pred-D_oracle)^2 / mean over pairs/queries/class-contrasts of D_oracle^2)
metrics.null_contrast_RMS: sqrt(mean squared predicted contrast); no normalization by zero oracle contrast
metrics.history_aggregation: average losses and squared errors; never average probabilities from different histories
metrics.denominators: positive and finite for positive-regime oracle-gap and contrast metrics; undefined cannot pass

metrics: positive primary M1 donor-minus-own expected-NLL contrast
bootstrap.draw_order: 2000x12 uniform integer person-pair indices in [0,12), then separate 2000x12 query-group indices in [0,12)
bootstrap.interval: 95 percent percentile; quantiles 0.025 and 0.975 with linear interpolation
bootstrap.person_unit: 12 whole adjacent matched pairs, both people retained
bootstrap.query_unit: 12 whole rotational groups, all 3 cases retained
bootstrap.aggregation: average history cell losses first; resample pairs/groups independently; normalize within person then average people
bootstrap.pairing: identical resample indices across models/paired contrasts
bootstrap.save: indices, hashes, replicate scalars, interval outputs
bootstrap.interpretation: conditional on fitted models and fixed support schedules; not retraining/domain uncertainty
bootstrap.gate_role: reported uncertainty, no new interval-based pass rule

curvature.scope: each saved per-seed informative M1 adaptation in primary and secondary policies; do not treat probability ensemble as one parameter fit
curvature.coordinates: 2 orthonormal offset-contrast coordinates and 2 personal interaction coordinates
curvature.penalized_units: data mean Hessian + diag(lambda_b_adapt I2, rho_adapt I2)
curvature.probabilities: saved-parameter fitted support probabilities, no oracle selection
report: data-only min eigenvalue and condition number
data-plus-ridge min eigenvalue and condition number
curvature.singularity: record singular/nonfinite state explicitly rather than invalid JSON numbers or exclusions

verification.expected_sets: derive exact stages, archives, array keys, metric rows, and ledger identities from frozen protocol; presence-conditional checks and upper bounds insufficient
verification.qualification: complete valid audit AND passed numerical checks AND complete saved-evidence replay AND all four primary gates separately on C and D
verification.artifact_identity: hash private artifacts before and after replay
verification.early_stop_interpretation: No scientific early stop is authorized here. A C gate failure still executes D; engineering/resource interruption is INCOMPLETE.

checkpoints: complete scientific code/protocol/expected IDs/zero-fit checks pushed and posted before fitting
execute declared C and D; no selection checkpoint
final report and draft PR with final SHA
scientific_failure: continue the other predeclared realization unless invalid execution/resource failure; preserve primary failure without tuning or rescue
text_next_spec: proposal only: representation meaning, leakage exclusions, semantic/template/paraphrase grouping, matched numerical control, frozen encoder admission/revision and training-only transforms; no encoder choice/download/experiment

parallel_coordination.instruction: consult current handoffs; do not duplicate, change or suspend independently authorized tracks
